newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung, LG Elec shares soar.
newsitem.headline: Samsung, LG Elec shares soar.

text.p: Shares of Samsung Electronics Co and LG Electronics Inc soared in late trading on Tuesday on expectations that the U.S. semiconductor industry's August book-to-bill ratio would improve against July, brokers said.
Samsung shares rose 3,300 won, or 5.79 percent, to 60,300 won, and LG Electronics shares gained 800 won, or 5.71 percent, to their upper limit of 14,800.
The U.S. Semiconductor Industry Association said it would release its August book-to-bill report on Tuesday.
A South Korean newspaper, Naewae Economic Daily, reported that analysts were forecasting the ratio to be 0.88, up from 0.85 in July.
U.S. analysts saw it coming in between 0.86 and 0.92.
"This news excited investors," said a Jardine Fleming broker.
The book-to-bill ratio measures new orders for computer chips against shipments.
